ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 5-8% distribution of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in circular ring structures.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the entire visible ventral field. High-contrast spatial mapping identifies distinct circular geometric rings scattered across both lobes, with a dense cluster on the distal right lobe and mid-upper left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 10% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by sharp peaks and valleys isolated against the high-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward trajectory on the lateral margins, transitioning to a moderate concave curve as the lobes converge at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings) mapped across the ventral surface, most notably on the distal third of the right lobe and the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant protruding calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes; widespread circular depigmentation scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle encrustation at the fluke tips creates a unique, highly irregular, three-dimensional pixel silhouette at the lobe extremities.
